title: WHEN ALIGNMENT HURTS: DECOUPLING REPRESENTATIONAL SPACES IN MULTILINGUAL MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generative performance on a Dialectal Machine Translation (DiaMT) task using chrF++ scores, and analyzing internal model representations using geometric separability (L2 and cosine distances), Subspace Angles (SSA), and information-theoretic probing to quantify representational entanglement between a dominant, high-resource standard language and underrepresented, low-resource dialects.
